criteria.text:
Given a run-mode scratch dir <runDir>/FAFF-9/spec-review under .faff/runs holding round-1.json with one objection and round-2.json approving
When faff spec-review collate-evidence --dir <scratch> --dispositions d.json --comment runs
Then stdout is the rendered evidence comment, exit is 0, and <runDir>/FAFF-9/spec-review-verdict.json exists
And that file's bytes equal the file faff evidence write spec-review-verdict --run-dir <otherRunDir> --issue FAFF-9 writes from the same stdout into a second, separate run dir
criteria.exercised: faff spec-review collate-evidence --dir .faff/runs/run-X/FAFF-9/spec-review --dispositions d.json --comment > c.md; faff evidence write spec-review-verdict --run-dir .faff/runs/run-Y --issue FAFF-9 < c.md; cmp run-X/FAFF-9/spec-review-verdict.json run-Y/FAFF-9/spec-review-verdict.json
criteria.expected: exit 0, stdout is the evidence comment, <runDir>/FAFF-9/spec-review-verdict.json exists and is byte-equal to the evidence-write replay into a separate run dir
criteria.observed: exit 0; stdout '## Spec-review evidence' comment ending in a sha256 line; run-X/FAFF-9/spec-review-verdict.json exists; replay into run-Y exit 0; cmp identical

criteria.text:
Given .faff/spec-review is a symlink to a directory outside the repository, holding FAFF-9/ with valid rounds
When faff spec-review collate-evidence --dir .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9 --dispositions d.json --comment runs
Then exit is 0, stdout is the full evidence comment, stderr contains "warning: spec-review-verdict.json not written", and no spec-review-verdict.json exists in the link target
criteria.exercised: ln -s <outside>/ext2 .faff/spec-review (ext2/FAFF-9 holds rounds); faff spec-review collate-evidence --dir .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9 --dispositions d.json --comment; find <outside>/ext2 -name 'spec-review-verdict*'
criteria.expected: exit 0, full comment on stdout, stderr contains 'warning: spec-review-verdict.json not written', no file in link target
criteria.observed: exit 0; stdout byte-identical to the run-mode comment; stderr 'faff spec-review collate-evidence: warning: spec-review-verdict.json not written: .faff/spec-review resolves outside the repository'; find empty

criteria.text:
Given <runDir>/FAFF-9/spec-review-verdict.json exists from an earlier review
When faff spec-review write-evidence --dir <runDir>/FAFF-9/spec-review --file comment.md runs with a comment whose sha256 line does not match
Then exit is 1 and <runDir>/FAFF-9/spec-review-verdict.json no longer exists
criteria.exercised: <runDir>/FAFF-9/spec-review-verdict.json present from earlier collate; faff spec-review write-evidence --dir .faff/runs/run-X/FAFF-9/spec-review --file bad.md (sha256 line zeroed); ls .faff/runs/run-X/FAFF-9
criteria.observed: exit 1; stderr 'refused: digest mismatch: ...'; ls shows only spec-review/

criteria.text:
Given an interactive scratch dir .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9 holding one objection-bearing round and one approving round
When faff spec-review collate-evidence --dir .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9 --dispositions d.json --comment runs
Then .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9/spec-review-verdict.json exists with schema_version 1 and exit is 0
criteria.exercised: mkdir .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9 with round-1 (revise, 1 objection) and round-2 (approve); faff spec-review collate-evidence --dir .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9 --dispositions d.json --comment; read schema_version

criteria.text:
Given a scratch dir outside both .faff/runs and .faff/spec-review holding valid rounds
When faff spec-review collate-evidence --dir <scratch> --dispositions d.json --comment runs
Then exit is 0, stdout is the full evidence comment, stderr contains "warning: spec-review-verdict.json not written", and no spec-review-verdict.json exists anywhere under the scratch dir or its parent
criteria.exercised: faff spec-review collate-evidence --dir other/FAFF-9/spec-review --dispositions d.json --comment; faff spec-review collate-evidence --dir other2/FAFF-9 --dispositions d.json --comment; find other other2 -name 'spec-review-verdict*'
criteria.expected: exit 0, full comment on stdout, stderr contains 'warning: spec-review-verdict.json not written', no file under scratch or parent
criteria.observed: both exit 0 with stdout byte-identical to the run-mode comment; stderr '... not written: --run-dir is not inside .faff/runs/' and '... not written: --dir is neither <run-dir>/<ISSUE>/spec-review nor .faff/spec-review/<ISSUE>'; find empty

criteria.text:
Given .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9 is a symlink to a directory outside the repository
When faff spec-review write-evidence --dir .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9 --file comment.md runs
Then exit is 2 and no spec-review-verdict.json is written in the symlink target
criteria.exercised: ln -s <outside>/ext6 .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9; faff spec-review write-evidence --dir .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9 --file c.md; ls -A <outside>/ext6
criteria.expected: exit 2, no spec-review-verdict.json in symlink target
criteria.observed: exit 2; stderr '--dir is neither <run-dir>/<ISSUE>/spec-review nor .faff/spec-review/<ISSUE>'; ext6 empty

criteria.text:
Given a carry comment holding the line "refresh: paths only, review carried forward", one path-move bullet, and an earlier evidence block with its matching sha256 line
When faff spec-review write-evidence --dir <run-mode scratch> --file carry-comment.md runs
Then exit is 0, stdout is the written path, and the file equals what collate-evidence wrote for the original comment
criteria.exercised: carry-comment.md = 'refresh: paths only, review carried forward' + one path-move bullet + original evidence block and sha256 line; faff spec-review write-evidence --dir .faff/runs/run-C/FAFF-9/spec-review --file carry-comment.md; cmp <collate-written file> run-C/FAFF-9/spec-review-verdict.json
criteria.expected: exit 0, stdout is the written path, file equals what collate-evidence wrote for the original comment
criteria.observed: exit 0; stdout '<repo>/.faff/runs/run-C/FAFF-9/spec-review-verdict.json'; cmp identical to the collate-evidence file

criteria.text:
Given a comment whose fenced block was edited after rendering so its sha256 line no longer matches
When faff spec-review write-evidence --dir <valid scratch> --file comment.md runs
Then exit is 1, stderr contains "refused: digest mismatch", and no file is written
criteria.exercised: edit rounds_total 2->3 inside the fenced block, keep sha256 line; faff spec-review write-evidence --dir .faff/runs/run-Z/FAFF-9/spec-review --file edited.md; find .faff/runs/run-Z -name 'spec-review-verdict*'
criteria.expected: exit 1, stderr contains 'refused: digest mismatch', no file written
criteria.observed: exit 1; stderr 'refused: digest mismatch: the evidence block was changed after it was rendered'; find empty

criteria.text: faff spec-review collate-evidence without --comment MUST NOT create spec-review-verdict.json in any directory.
criteria.exercised: faff spec-review collate-evidence --dir .faff/runs/run-X/FAFF-9/spec-review --dispositions d.json; faff spec-review collate-evidence --dir .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9 --dispositions d.json; faff spec-review collate-evidence --dir other2/FAFF-9; find for spec-review-verdict* after each
criteria.expected: no spec-review-verdict.json created by runs without --comment
criteria.observed: all exit 0 printing the JSON record; find empty after each (run-mode, interactive, other dir)

criteria.text: faff evidence write spec-review-verdict with a --run-dir outside .faff/runs MUST still exit 2.
criteria.exercised: faff evidence write spec-review-verdict --run-dir <tmp>/outside --issue FAFF-9 < c.md; faff evidence write spec-review-verdict --run-dir notruns/r --issue FAFF-9 < c.md
criteria.observed: both exit 2; stderr '--run-dir is not inside .faff/runs/'; no file written

criteria.text: `collate-evidence --comment`, run against a run-mode scratch, leaves `<runDir>/<ISSUE>/spec-review-verdict.json` on disk with no further command.
criteria.expected: <runDir>/<ISSUE>/spec-review-verdict.json on disk after that one command
criteria.observed: exit 0; ls shows spec-review-verdict.json next to spec-review/

criteria.text: `placeSpecReviewEvidence` returns `mode: interactive` for a direct child of a real `.faff/spec-review/` and `mode: run` for `<runDir>/<ISSUE>/spec-review` with `runDir` under `.faff/runs/`. It throws `WriterFault` for any other directory, for a symlinked child that resolves outside, for a `.faff` or `.faff/spec-review` that is itself a symlink, and for an invalid issue id.
criteria.exercised: collate-evidence --comment on .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9 and on .faff/runs/run-X/FAFF-9/spec-review; collate-evidence --comment on other/FAFF-9/spec-review and other2/FAFF-9; write-evidence on symlinked .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9, symlinked .faff/spec-review, symlinked .faff (target outside and inside repo); write-evidence on .faff/spec-review/FAFF..9, .hidden, 'a b'
criteria.expected: interactive and run placements accepted; other dirs, symlinked child, symlinked .faff or .faff/spec-review, invalid issue id refused
criteria.observed: interactive written into the scratch dir; run written into <runDir>/FAFF-9; other dirs 'not written' warnings; symlinked child exit 2 '--dir is neither...'; symlinked .faff (both cases) and .faff/spec-review 'resolves outside the repository' (exit 2 / warning); FAFF..9, .hidden, 'a b' exit 2 '--dir is not a valid spec-review scratch dir'; no file in any refused target

criteria.text: `collate-evidence --comment` stdout is byte-identical before and after this change for the same inputs, and on success stderr includes exactly one line `faff spec-review collate-evidence: wrote <path>` (existing `skipped …` lines may also appear).
criteria.exercised: faff spec-review collate-evidence ... --comment for run-mode, interactive, symlinked and outside scratch dirs; cmp the stdouts; count stderr lines on success
criteria.expected: stdout is the rendered comment unchanged by the write; on success exactly one stderr line 'faff spec-review collate-evidence: wrote <path>'
criteria.observed: stdout byte-identical across successful and failed writes and replays cleanly through faff evidence write; success stderr is 1 line, 1 'wrote' line. No pre-change binary was run (outside the permitted surface)

criteria.text: A relative `--dir` of `.faff/spec-review/<ISSUE>` places correctly when the command runs from a subdirectory of the repository.
criteria.exercised: cd sub/deep && faff spec-review write-evidence --dir .faff/spec-review/FAFF-9 --file c4.md; find sub -type f; cmp with the collate-written interactive file
criteria.expected: relative .faff/spec-review/<ISSUE> resolves against the repo root from a subdirectory
criteria.observed: exit 0; stdout '<repo>/.faff/spec-review/FAFF-9/spec-review-verdict.json'; nothing under sub/; bytes identical to the collate-evidence file. (collate-evidence from the subdir exits 2 'cannot read round files', since round reading stays cwd-relative as the spec leaves it)

delegated.text: The diff adds no `require` of `node:http`, `node:https`, `node:net` or any tracker adapter module to `spec-review.js` or `evidence.js`.
`guardWriterPaths` is byte-unchanged, and `faff evidence write spec-review-verdict` with a `--run-dir` outside `.faff/runs` still exits 2.
A test in `test/` asserts that, for both modes, `placeSpecReviewEvidence(specReviewDir(issue, runDir))` returns the expected `target_dir` and `mode`, pinning the duplicated scratch layout.
`writeSpecReviewVerdict(runDir, issue, …)` delegates to `writeSpecReviewVerdictTo`, and every existing case in `test/evidence-write.test.mjs` passes unchanged.

On a placement fault or a writer refusal, `collate-evidence --comment` exits 0, prints the comment, and stderr includes exactly one line beginning `faff spec-review collate-evidence: warning: spec-review-verdict.json not written:`.

After a placed-but-refused write from either command, no `spec-review-verdict.json` remains in the target. After a placed write that faults, an earlier file is at `spec-review-verdict.stale.json`, not the canonical path.
The `--from-judge --spec … --comment` path writes the same file as the `--dispositions` path when both resolve to the same dispositions.

`write-evidence` exits 0 and writes the file for a carry comment. It exits 1 with `refused:` for a digest mismatch or a missing section, and exits 2 for missing flags, an unreadable `--file`, or a placement fault.
The file `collate-evidence` writes is byte-identical to the file `faff evidence write spec-review-verdict` writes from its stdout.
`faff-prep/SKILL.md` :263 carries the two in-place replacements, and :553 carries the `write-evidence` call. No other prose changes.
`faff-prep/SKILL.md` stays at or under 611 lines, its :263 line stays at or under 200 words, and `faff validate-adapters` passes with `SKILL_LINE_BASELINE` unchanged.
`docs/guide/cli.md` documents the `collate-evidence` side effect and the `write-evidence` row.
Running the terminal seam twice leaves one file whose bytes match the latest comment.
Round readers ignore `spec-review-verdict.json` in an interactive scratch. A test runs `collateSpecReviewRounds` on a dir that holds the file and reports no skip for it.

New tests live in `test/`, for example `test/spec-review-evidence-write.test.mjs`, run under `node --test`, and cover every item above using a temp git root with `.faff/runs` and `.faff/spec-review`, as `test/evidence-write.test.mjs` does.
The collate-evidence cases in the `spec-review.js` selftest (:240-259) move into `test/` and are deleted from the selftest block. No new selftest cases are added to either module.
